title: The Human Genome Project announces completion
summary: The international consortium announced completion of the Human Genome Project and made its sequence data freely available for research.

citations.locator: 14 April 2003 release; finished-sequence definition, remaining gaps and public data release
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: The international consortium announced completion of the Human Genome Project and made its sequence data freely available for research.
The record dates the public completion announcement on 14 April 2003, rather than later gap-closing work.
“Finished” meant a highly accurate reference covering about 99% of gene-containing regions. Difficult sequences still left gaps; this was not a gapless human genome.

review.corroboration: The contemporaneous NHGRI release was inspected, including its explicit remaining-gap definition. No second independent account was established for this record.
